senses.definition_en: to put, to place (cause to assume a specified position)

senses.definition_en: to attach, to assign (also in an abstract sense)

examples.english: Adding a soundtrack to movies adds emotion.
examples.text: Ponerle una banda sonora a las películas añade emoción.
examples.translation: Adding a soundtrack to movies adds emotion.

examples.text: En 2020, muchos países pusieron restricciones al turismo.
examples.translation: In 2020, many countries imposed restrictions on tourism.

glosses: to attach, to assign (also in an abstract sense)

senses.definition_en: to give, to provide

examples.translation: What can I get you to drink?

examples.english: Carlos is hosting, I'm bringing the drinks. (Carlos is providing the house, I'm providing the drinks)
examples.text: Carlos pone la casa, yo pongo los refrescos.

examples.translation: Let me give you an example.

glosses: to give, to provide

senses.definition_en: (transitive) to put (cause to assume a specified state), (reflexive) to become, to get, to put oneself in a specified state

examples.english: The city of Providence has put into effect the temporary storm parking ban until further notice.
examples.text: La ciudad de Providence ya puso en efecto la prohibición temporal de estacionamiento durante la tormenta hasta nuevo aviso.
examples.translation: The city of Providence has put into effect the temporary storm parking ban until further notice.

examples.english: Put these numbers in order from least to greatest.
examples.text: Pon estos números de menor a mayor.
examples.translation: Put these numbers in order from least to greatest.

examples.english: You're making me nervous.
examples.text: Me estás poniendo nerviosa.
examples.translation: You're making me nervous.

examples.english: Turn up the music.
examples.text: Pongan la música más alta.
examples.translation: Turn up the music.

examples.english: I put the boy to work.
examples.text: Puse al niño a trabajar.
examples.translation: I put the boy to work.

examples.english: My manipulative ex-wife turned my own friends against me.
examples.text: Mi ex-esposa manipuladora puso a mis propios amigos en mi contra.
examples.translation: My manipulative ex-wife turned my own friends against me.

examples.english: We need to get them on our side.
examples.text: Necesitamos ponerlos de nuestra parte.
examples.translation: We need to get them on our side.

examples.english: When you travel by plane, put your phone in airplane mode.
examples.text: Cuando viajes en avión, pon el celular en modo avión.
examples.translation: When you travel by plane, put your phone in airplane mode.

examples.english: Get on your knees!
examples.text: ¡Ponte de rodillas!
examples.translation: Get on your knees!

examples.english: I don't like getting in front of the camera.
examples.text: No me gusta ponerme en frente de la cámara.
examples.translation: I don't like getting in front of the camera.

examples.english: She gets aggressive when anyone touches her.
examples.text: Se pone agresiva cuando alguien la toca.
examples.translation: She gets aggressive when anyone touches her.

examples.english: He got very sick after eating the rotten food.
examples.text: Se puso muy enfermo después de comerse la comida descompuesta.
examples.translation: He got very sick after eating the rotten food.

examples.english: The ham turned dry.
examples.text: El jamón se puso seco.
examples.translation: The ham turned dry.

examples.english: Smarten up for the party.
examples.text: Ponte guapa para la fiesta.
examples.translation: Smarten up for the party.

examples.english: Do not put yourself in harm's way.
examples.text: No te pongas en peligro.
examples.translation: Do not put yourself in harm's way.

examples.english: We'll get in contact (with you) shortly.
examples.text: Nos pondremos en contacto a la brevedad.
examples.translation: We'll get in contact (with you) shortly.

examples.english: Stop. You're making me nervous.
examples.text: Basta. Me estás poniendo nerviosa.
examples.translation: Stop. You're making me nervous.

glosses: (transitive) to put (cause to assume a specified state), (reflexive) to become, to get, to put oneself in a specified state
